description: Indulge in the quintessential taste of New England with this classic Maine Lobster Roll. Succulent, sweet lobster meat is lightly dressed with mayonnaise and a hint of lemon, then piled high into a perfectly buttered and toasted split-top bun. This iconic American seafood dish is simple yet utterly luxurious, delivering a burst of fresh ocean flavor with every bite.

ingredients.item: New England style split-top hot dog buns

instructions.title: Prepare the Lobster
instructions.text: If using whole lobsters, bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Add lobsters headfirst, cover, and cook for 8-10 minutes for 1.25 lb lobsters, or until bright red. Remove lobsters and plunge into an ice bath to stop cooking. Once cool enough to handle, remove the meat from the tails, claws, and knuckles.

instructions.title: Chop the Lobster Meat
instructions.text: Roughly chop the cooked lobster meat into bite-sized pieces. Ensure no shell fragments remain. Place the chopped lobster meat into a medium-sized mixing bowl.

instructions.title: Make the Dressing
instructions.text: In a small bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, fresh lemon juice, salt, and black pepper until well combined. This simple dressing allows the natural sweetness of the lobster to shine.

instructions.title: Combine and Chill
instructions.text: Pour the mayonnaise mixture over the chopped lobster meat. Gently fold the ingredients together until the lobster is lightly coated. Avoid overmixing. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes to allow the flavors to meld and the mixture to chill.

instructions.title: Toast the Buns
instructions.text: Melt the unsalted butter in a large skillet over medium-low heat. Brush the outsides of the split-top hot dog buns with the melted butter. Place the buttered sides down in the skillet and toast for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and slightly crispy.

instructions.title: Assemble the Rolls
instructions.text: Carefully open each toasted bun. Evenly divide the chilled lobster mixture among the four buns, piling it generously into the buttered crevices.

instructions.title: Garnish and Serve
instructions.text: Garnish with a sprinkle of fresh chives or parsley, if desired. Serve immediately with a side of potato chips, coleslaw, or a pickle spear for a truly authentic New England experience.

tips: Always use fresh, high-quality lobster meat for the best flavor; frozen or pre-cooked lobster can be used but may lack the same sweetness and texture.
Do not overdress the lobster. The goal is to enhance, not mask, the delicate flavor of the lobster. A light coating of mayonnaise is key for an authentic Maine-style roll.
Serve immediately after assembling to enjoy the contrast between the warm, buttery bun and the cool, succulent lobster filling. A side of kettle chips completes the classic experience.
